The bar of a Smith machine, running on two vertical guide rails, across the upper back and shoulders, hands gripping it outside the shoulders, knees softly bent about 15 degrees.
smith-machine-good-morning.end_position: Hips pushed back and the torso hinged forward until it is nearly parallel to the floor, spine neutral and long, knees still at the same soft bend, the Smith bar lowered on its rails with the upper back, head in line with the spine.

smith-machine-hip-thrust.start_position: Upper back and shoulder blades resting on the edge of a flat bench under the bar of a Smith machine, hips down near the floor, both feet flat on the floor with the knees bent about 90 degrees. The padded Smith bar resting across the crease of the hips, hands holding it either side.
smith-machine-hip-thrust.end_position: Hips driven up so the shoulders, hips and knees form one straight line, shins vertical, weight through the heels, glutes squeezed, the Smith bar lifted on its rails with the hips. Upper back still on the bench, chin tucked.

smith-machine-reverse-lunge.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. The bar of a Smith machine, running on two vertical guide rails, rests across the upper back and shoulders with the hands gripping it outside the shoulders.
smith-machine-reverse-lunge.end_position: Stepped backward with the left foot into a lunge: the right (front) knee bent to 90 degrees directly over the right foot, the left knee lowered to just above the floor behind, left heel up, torso upright. The bar of a Smith machine, running on two vertical guide rails, rests across the upper back and shoulders with the hands gripping it outside the shoulders. Feet in a long split stance.

smith-machine-romanian-deadlift.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. Knees softly bent about 15 degrees, hips stacked under the shoulders, shoulders back. The bar of a Smith machine, running on two vertical guide rails, gripped at shoulder width and held at the front of the thighs on straight arms.
smith-machine-romanian-deadlift.end_position: Hips pushed back behind the heels and the torso hinged forward to about 45 degrees above horizontal, spine still neutral and long, knees still at the same soft 15 degree bend, head in line with the spine. The bar of a Smith machine, running on two vertical guide rails, gripped at shoulder width and held hanging close against the shins at mid-shin height on straight arms.

smith-machine-shoulder-press.start_position: Seated tall on an upright bench, feet flat on the floor, back against the pad. The bar of a Smith machine, running on two vertical guide rails, gripped a little wider than the shoulders and held at shoulder height with the elbows bent and pointing down and slightly forward, palms facing forward, forearms vertical.
smith-machine-shoulder-press.end_position: Seated tall on an upright bench, feet flat on the floor, back against the pad. The bar of a Smith machine, running on two vertical guide rails, gripped a little wider than the shoulders and held pressed straight overhead, arms fully extended with the biceps beside the ears, elbows locked, wrists straight, ribs down. Only the arms have moved.

smith-machine-shrug.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. The bar of a Smith machine, running on two vertical guide rails, gripped at shoulder width and held at the front of the thighs hanging on straight arms, shoulders relaxed down.
smith-machine-shrug.end_position: Both shoulders shrugged straight up toward the ears as high as they go, arms still straight, the bar of a smith machine, running on two vertical guide rails, gripped at shoulder width and held at the front of the thighs lifted a few inches with them, head level and not tilted. Only the shoulders have moved.

smith-machine-upright-row.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. The bar of a Smith machine, running on two vertical guide rails, gripped hanging at the front of the thighs on straight arms with an overhand grip at hip width.
smith-machine-upright-row.end_position: The bar of a Smith machine, running on two vertical guide rails, gripped pulled straight up the front of the body to mid-chest height, elbows bent and driven up and out so they lead above the hands, wrists below the elbows. Torso upright. Only the arms have moved.

snatch-pull.start_position: Set-up over a barbell loaded with plates on the floor: feet hip width, the bar over mid-foot, hips hinged back and higher than the knees, knees bent about 45 degrees, flat back angled about 45 degrees above horizontal, arms straight with the hands gripping the bar just outside the knees, shoulders over the bar. The grip is very wide, hands well outside the knees near the collars.
snatch-pull.end_position: Standing tall at lockout with the barbell hanging at the front of the thighs on straight arms, hips and knees fully extended, shoulders back, spine neutral. Fully extended at the top of the pull: up on the balls of the feet, hips driven forward, shoulders shrugged hard up toward the ears, arms still straight with the bar at the hips, wide grip unchanged, head tall.

spanish-squat-isometric-hold.start_position: Squat held with a stiff strap looped around a post in front and behind both knees: feet hip width and flat, shins exactly vertical and pulled forward against the strap, knees bent to about 90 degrees so the thighs are parallel to the floor, torso upright, arms extended forward at shoulder height for balance.
spanish-squat-isometric-hold.end_position: Squat held with a stiff strap looped around a post in front and behind both knees: feet hip width and flat, shins exactly vertical and pulled forward against the strap, knees bent to about 90 degrees so the thighs are parallel to the floor, torso upright, arms extended forward at shoulder height for balance.

spider-curl.start_position: Lying chest down on a bench inclined about 45 degrees, chest and belly on the pad, feet on the floor behind. Both arms hanging straight down in front of the pad with a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward, upper arms vertical.
spider-curl.end_position: Both dumbbells curled up until the forearms are horizontal and the hands are near the chin, upper arms still hanging vertical and not swinging, chest on the pad. Only the elbows have moved.

split-stance-iso-telemark.start_position: Deep split stance held still: right foot forward with the right knee bent to about 90 degrees over the foot, left leg back with the left knee bent and hovering just above the floor behind, left heel raised, torso upright with the weight mostly on the front leg, arms bent at the sides as if holding ski poles.
split-stance-iso-telemark.end_position: Deep split stance held still: right foot forward with the right knee bent to about 90 degrees over the foot, left leg back with the left knee bent and hovering just above the floor behind, left heel raised, torso upright with the weight mostly on the front leg, arms bent at the sides as if holding ski poles.

squat-band.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. Feet shoulder width with the toes slightly out. A resistance band looped over both shoulders and under both feet, taut along the front of the torso and legs.
squat-band.end_position: Bottom of the squat: hips and knees bent so the thighs are at or just below parallel, knees tracking out over the toes, heels flat, torso leaning forward about 20 degrees with the spine neutral and the chest up. A resistance band looped over both shoulders and under both feet, taut along the front of the torso and legs. unchanged in position on the body.

squat-barbell.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. Feet shoulder width with the toes slightly out. A barbell across the upper back and shoulders, hands gripping the bar outside the shoulders.
squat-barbell.end_position: Bottom of the squat: hips and knees bent so the thighs are at or just below parallel, knees tracking out over the toes, heels flat, torso leaning forward about 20 degrees with the spine neutral and the chest up. A barbell across the upper back and shoulders, hands gripping the bar outside the shoulders. unchanged in position on the body.

squat-dumbbell.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. Feet shoulder width with the toes slightly out. A dumbbell hanging in each hand at the sides on straight arms.
squat-dumbbell.end_position: Bottom of the squat: hips and knees bent so the thighs are at or just below parallel, knees tracking out over the toes, heels flat, torso leaning forward about 20 degrees with the spine neutral and the chest up. A dumbbell hanging in each hand at the sides on straight arms. unchanged in position on the body.

squat-machine.start_position: Standing on the platform of a squat machine with the shoulders under the padded shoulder pads and the hands on the handles, feet shoulder width, legs straight, torso upright.
squat-machine.end_position: Lowered so the knees are bent to about 90 degrees and the thighs are parallel to the platform, shoulders still under the pads, feet flat, torso upright. Only the knees and hips have bent.

squat-smith-machine.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. Feet shoulder width with the toes slightly out. The bar of a Smith machine, running on two vertical guide rails, rests across the upper back and shoulders with the hands gripping it outside the shoulders, feet set slightly forward of the bar line.
squat-smith-machine.end_position: Bottom of the squat: hips and knees bent so the thighs are at or just below parallel, knees tracking out over the toes, heels flat, torso leaning forward about 20 degrees with the spine neutral and the chest up. The bar of a Smith machine, running on two vertical guide rails, rests across the upper back and shoulders with the hands gripping it outside the shoulders, feet set slightly forward of the bar line. unchanged in position on the body.

stiff-leg-deadlift.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. A barbell held in both hands at the front of the thighs on straight arms, knees nearly straight with only a slight bend.
stiff-leg-deadlift.end_position: Hips pushed back and the torso hinged forward until it is nearly parallel to the floor, spine neutral and long, knees still nearly straight with the same slight bend, arms straight with the bar hanging close to the shins at mid-shin height, head in line with the spine.

straight-leg-deadlift-band.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. Standing on the middle of a heavy resistance band with both feet, both hands gripping the band ends at the front of the thighs on straight arms, knees nearly straight with only a slight bend, band taut.
straight-leg-deadlift-band.end_position: Hips pushed back and the torso hinged forward until it is nearly parallel to the floor, spine neutral and long, knees still nearly straight, arms straight with the hands at mid-shin height and the band slack, head in line with the spine.

strict-military-press-barbell.start_position: Standing tall with the feet together, a barbell held in both hands a little wider than the shoulders in the front rack at collarbone height, elbows bent and pointing down and slightly forward, forearms vertical, ribs down.
strict-military-press-barbell.end_position: The bar pressed straight overhead, arms fully extended with the biceps beside the ears, elbows locked, head pushed slightly forward under the bar, knees straight, feet still together, no lean back. Only the arms have moved.

sumo-deadlift.start_position: Set-up over a barbell loaded with plates on the floor in a wide sumo stance: feet well wider than the shoulders with the toes turned out about 40 degrees, knees bent and pushed out over the toes, hips low, torso upright with a flat back, arms straight and hanging inside the legs with both hands gripping the bar at shoulder width, shoulders over the bar.
sumo-deadlift.end_position: Standing tall at lockout with the barbell hanging at the front of the thighs on straight arms, hips and knees fully extended, feet still in the wide turned-out stance, shoulders back, spine neutral.

t-bar-row.start_position: Straddling a barbell anchored in a landmine behind, feet either side of the bar, hips hinged so the torso is about 45 degrees above horizontal with a flat back, knees slightly bent. Both hands gripping a V-handle hooked under the bar near the loaded end, arms straight and hanging down.
t-bar-row.end_position: The bar end rowed up to the lower chest: elbows bent and driven back and up past the torso, shoulder blades squeezed together, hinge angle and knees unchanged. Only the arms have moved.

table-inverted-row.start_position: Lying on the back on the floor under a sturdy dining table, both hands gripping the table's edge above the chest with an overhand grip, arms fully straight, body one straight line from the shoulders to the heels with the heels on the floor and the hips lifted off it.
table-inverted-row.end_position: Pulled up so the chest touches the underside of the table edge: elbows bent and driven back past the torso, shoulder blades squeezed together, body still one straight line from shoulders to heels, heels on the floor. Only the arms have moved.

thruster-barbell.start_position: Bottom of a front squat with a barbell in the front rack: the bar resting across the front of the shoulders and collarbones, elbows high and pointing forward, hips and knees bent so the thighs are below parallel, knees tracking out over the toes, heels flat, torso upright.
thruster-barbell.end_position: Standing tall with the bar pressed overhead: arms fully extended with the biceps beside the ears, elbows locked, hips and knees fully extended, feet flat, torso vertical, head pushed slightly forward under the bar.

thruster-kettlebell.start_position: Bottom of a front squat with a kettlebell in each hand in the rack position: elbows tucked against the ribs, forearms vertical, the bells resting on the outside of the forearms against the front of the shoulders, hips and knees bent so the thighs are below parallel, knees out over the toes, heels flat, torso upright.
thruster-kettlebell.end_position: Standing tall with both kettlebells pressed overhead: arms fully extended with the bells resting on the backs of the forearms, elbows locked, hips and knees fully extended, feet flat, torso vertical.

tibialis-raise.start_position: Lower legs only, from the knees down. Standing with both heels against the base of a wall and the feet a few inches out in front, feet flat on the floor with the toes down, knees straight, weight back on the heels. The shin muscles at the front of the lower leg drawn as the accent.
tibialis-raise.end_position: Both forefeet lifted as high as they go with the heels still on the floor against the wall, ankles fully flexed so the toes point up toward the shins, knees straight. Only the ankles have moved.

toes-to-bar.start_position: Dead hang from a pull-up bar: both hands on the bar shoulder width, palms forward, arms straight, shoulders engaged. Legs hanging straight down together, toes pointed, body still.
toes-to-bar.end_position: Both straight legs swung up together so the toes touch the bar between the hands, hips fully flexed and the pelvis curled up, arms still nearly straight, body folded in half under the bar. Grip unchanged.

torso-rotation-machine.start_position: Seated in a torso rotation machine with the chest against the pad and the hands on the handles, thighs locked under the pads, torso rotated to the left against the machine's resistance arm.
torso-rotation-machine.end_position: Torso rotated through to the right against the resistance arm, hips and thighs still locked in place and facing forward, chest still against the pad, hands on the handles. Only the trunk has rotated.

towel-door-row.start_position: Standing facing a closed door with a towel looped around both door handles, both hands gripping the towel ends, feet close to the base of the door, body leaning straight back from the heels at about 45 degrees with the arms fully straight and the weight hanging on the towel.
towel-door-row.end_position: Pulled in so the chest is close to the door: elbows bent and driven back past the torso, shoulder blades squeezed together, body still one straight line from the heels to the head, feet unchanged. Only the arms have moved.

trap-bar-shrug.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. A hexagonal trap bar held by its side handles at the sides of the thighs hanging on straight arms, shoulders relaxed down.
trap-bar-shrug.end_position: Both shoulders shrugged straight up toward the ears as high as they go, arms still straight, a hexagonal trap bar held by its side handles at the sides of the thighs lifted a few inches with them, head level and not tilted. Only the shoulders have moved.

trapeze-plank-hold.start_position: High plank with the feet up on a low bench behind and both hands flat on the floor under the shoulders, arms straight and locked, body one straight line from the head through the hips to the heels, sloping down from the bench to the hands, head neutral with the eyes on the floor.
trapeze-plank-hold.end_position: High plank with the feet up on a low bench behind and both hands flat on the floor under the shoulders, arms straight and locked, body one straight line from the head through the hips to the heels, sloping down from the bench to the hands, head neutral with the eyes on the floor.

tricep-kickback.start_position: Hinged forward at the hips with a flat back, torso nearly parallel to the floor, left hand braced on a flat bench, feet staggered. A dumbbell in the right hand with the right upper arm pinned parallel to the torso, elbow bent to 90 degrees so the forearm hangs straight down, palm facing in.
tricep-kickback.end_position: The right elbow extended fully so the arm is straight and in line with the torso, dumbbell behind the hip, upper arm still pinned parallel to the torso and not lifting. Left hand still on the bench. Only the elbow has moved.

tricep-pushdown.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. Facing a cable machine with the pulley set high, a V-shaped bar attachment held in both hands with an overhand grip at upper chest height, elbows bent fully and pinned at the sides, forearms angled up, cable taut up to the pulley.
tricep-pushdown.end_position: Both forearms pressed down until the arms are fully straight, a V-shaped bar attachment at the front of the thighs, elbows still pinned at the sides and not drifting forward, wrists straight, cable taut. Torso upright. Only the elbows have moved.

triceps-dip.start_position: Support position at the top of a pair of parallel dip bars: both arms straight and locked with the hands on the bars, torso upright and vertical, knees bent with the feet crossed behind, shoulders down away from the ears.
triceps-dip.end_position: Bottom of the dip: elbows bent to about 90 degrees pointing back so the upper arms are parallel to the floor, torso upright and vertical, lowered between the bars, knees still bent with the feet crossed behind. Hands still on the bars.

triceps-dip-assisted.start_position: Support position at the top of a pair of parallel dip bars: both arms straight and locked with the hands on the bars, torso upright and vertical, knees bent with the feet crossed behind, shoulders down away from the ears. A thick resistance band is looped across the two bars with the left knee resting on it, the right foot crossed behind.
triceps-dip-assisted.end_position: Bottom of the dip: elbows bent to about 90 degrees pointing back so the upper arms are parallel to the floor, torso upright and vertical, lowered between the bars, knees still bent with the feet crossed behind. Hands still on the bars. A thick resistance band is looped across the two bars with the left knee resting on it, the right foot crossed behind.

triceps-extension.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. A single dumbbell held overhead in the right hand, arms fully extended straight up, upper arms beside the ears, elbows locked, ribs down.
triceps-extension.end_position: A single dumbbell lowered behind the head by bending only at the elbows to about 90 degrees, forearms angled down behind the head, upper arms still vertical beside the ears and not flaring out. Ribs down, spine neutral, torso upright.

triceps-extension-barbell.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. A barbell with a shoulder-width grip held overhead in both hands, arms fully extended straight up, upper arms beside the ears, elbows locked, ribs down.
triceps-extension-barbell.end_position: A barbell with a shoulder-width grip lowered behind the head by bending only at the elbows to about 90 degrees, forearms angled down behind the head, upper arms still vertical beside the ears and not flaring out. Ribs down, spine neutral, torso upright.

triceps-extension-cable.start_position: Standing facing away from a cable column with the pulley set low, in a staggered stance, torso leaning forward about 20 degrees. A rope attachment held in both hands behind the head with the elbows bent to about 90 degrees and pointing forward and up beside the ears, forearms angled back, cable taut down to the pulley behind.
triceps-extension-cable.end_position: Both arms extended fully forward and up so the rope ends are in front of and above the head, upper arms still beside the ears and not dropping, elbows locked, cable stretched taut from the low pulley behind. Only the elbows have moved.

triceps-extension-dumbbell.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. One dumbbell held by cupping its upper plate held overhead in both hands, arms fully extended straight up, upper arms beside the ears, elbows locked, ribs down.
triceps-extension-dumbbell.end_position: One dumbbell held by cupping its upper plate lowered behind the head by bending only at the elbows to about 90 degrees, forearms angled down behind the head, upper arms still vertical beside the ears and not flaring out. Ribs down, spine neutral, torso upright.

triceps-extension-machine.start_position: Seated in a triceps extension machine with the chest against the pad and both upper arms resting flat along the sloped arm pad, elbows at the bottom of the pad. Both hands gripping the handles with the elbows fully bent and the forearms angled up toward the shoulders.
triceps-extension-machine.end_position: Both arms extended fully so the forearms point straight out along the line of the pad, hands far in front, elbows still pinned on the pad, upper arms unchanged. Only the elbows have moved.

triceps-pushdown-cable-straight-bar.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. Facing a cable machine with the pulley set high, a straight bar attachment held in both hands with an overhand grip at upper chest height, elbows bent fully and pinned at the sides, forearms angled up, cable taut up to the pulley.
triceps-pushdown-cable-straight-bar.end_position: Both forearms pressed down until the arms are fully straight, a straight bar attachment at the front of the thighs, elbows still pinned at the sides and not drifting forward, wrists straight, cable taut. Torso upright. Only the elbows have moved.

tuck-hold.start_position: Ski tuck held still: feet hip width and flat with the shins pressed forward as if in ski boots, knees and hips bent so the thighs are just above parallel and the chest is over the thighs, back flat, both forearms resting along the tops of the thighs with the hands forward, head up with the eyes forward.
tuck-hold.end_position: Ski tuck held still: feet hip width and flat with the shins pressed forward as if in ski boots, knees and hips bent so the thighs are just above parallel and the chest is over the thighs, back flat, both forearms resting along the tops of the thighs with the hands forward, head up with the eyes forward.

turkish-get-up.start_position: Lying on the back on the floor with a kettlebell pressed straight up in the right hand, right arm locked vertical with the bell resting on the back of the forearm, right knee bent with the right foot flat, left leg straight along the floor, left arm out to the side on the floor at 45 degrees, eyes on the bell.
turkish-get-up.end_position: Standing tall with the kettlebell still locked out overhead on a straight right arm directly above the shoulder, feet hip width, left arm at the side, torso vertical, eyes forward.

turkish-get-up-light.start_position: Lying on the back on the floor with a light kettlebell pressed straight up in the right hand, right arm locked vertical, right knee bent with the right foot flat, left leg straight along the floor, left arm out to the side on the floor at 45 degrees, eyes on the bell.
turkish-get-up-light.end_position: Standing tall with the kettlebell still locked out overhead on a straight right arm directly above the shoulder, feet hip width, left arm at the side, torso vertical, eyes forward.

typewriter-pull-up.start_position: Hanging from a pull-up bar with a wide grip, held at the top of a pull-up with the chin above the bar and the body shifted all the way over to the right hand: the right elbow fully bent with the bar at the right side of the chest, the left arm nearly straight and extended along the bar to the left. Legs hanging straight down together, toes pointed.
typewriter-pull-up.end_position: Hanging from a pull-up bar with a wide grip, held at the top of a pull-up with the chin above the bar and the body shifted all the way over to the right hand: the right elbow fully bent with the bar at the right side of the chest, the left arm nearly straight and extended along the bar to the left. Legs hanging straight down together, toes pointed.

ultimate-layout-plank.start_position: Forearm plank with the left forearm on the floor and the elbow under the shoulder, toes tucked under, body one straight line from head to heels. The right arm reached straight forward past the head to full extension, parallel to the floor with the palm down, hips level and square with no rotation.
ultimate-layout-plank.end_position: Forearm plank with the left forearm on the floor and the elbow under the shoulder, toes tucked under, body one straight line from head to heels. The right arm reached straight forward past the head to full extension, parallel to the floor with the palm down, hips level and square with no rotation.

upright-row-barbell.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. A barbell held in both hands hanging at the front of the thighs on straight arms with an overhand grip at hip width.
upright-row-barbell.end_position: A barbell held in both hands pulled straight up the front of the body to mid-chest height, elbows bent and driven up and out so they lead above the hands, wrists below the elbows. Torso upright. Only the arms have moved.

v-up.start_position: Lying flat on the back on the floor, both arms extended straight overhead along the floor, legs straight and together, toes pointed.
v-up.end_position: Folded into a V: straight legs raised to about 45 degrees and the torso raised to meet them, both arms reaching straight forward toward the toes, balanced on the tailbone, back straight. Legs and arms straight.

wall-sit-ski-tuck.start_position: Wall sit: back flat against a wall, hips and knees both bent to 90 degrees so the thighs are parallel to the floor and the shins vertical, feet flat shoulder width apart, both forearms resting along the tops of the thighs with the hands forward as in a ski tuck, head against the wall, eyes forward.
wall-sit-ski-tuck.end_position: Wall sit: back flat against a wall, hips and knees both bent to 90 degrees so the thighs are parallel to the floor and the shins vertical, feet flat shoulder width apart, both forearms resting along the tops of the thighs with the hands forward as in a ski tuck, head against the wall, eyes forward.

weighted-carve-squat.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. A weight plate held flat against the chest with both hands, feet shoulder width with the toes out.
weighted-carve-squat.end_position: Bottom of the squat with the thighs parallel to the floor, knees out over the toes, heels flat, and the torso rotated to the right so the plate at the chest points toward the right knee, spine long. Rotated squat, feet unchanged.

wrist-curl-dumbbell.start_position: Seated on the end of a flat bench, both forearms resting flat along the tops of the thighs with the wrists hanging just past the knees, palms up. A dumbbell in each hand held with the wrists dropped so the hands hang down below the knees.
wrist-curl-dumbbell.end_position: The wrists curled up so the hands point up and a dumbbell in each hand is lifted as high as the wrists allow, forearms still flat on the thighs, elbows unchanged, palms up. Only the wrists have moved.

yogi-pushup-chaturanga.start_position: High plank shifted slightly forward: hands flat on the mat under the shoulders, arms straight, feet together with the toes on the mat, body one straight line from head to heels, head neutral.
yogi-pushup-chaturanga.end_position: Lowered into chaturanga: elbows bent to exactly 90 degrees and tucked tight against the sides of the ribs pointing straight back, upper arms parallel to the floor, body still one straight line from head to heels hovering a few inches above the mat with no hip sag. Hands unchanged.

zercher-good-morning.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. A barbell cradled in the crooks of both elbows against the torso at waist height, hands clasped together in front of the chest, knees softly bent about 15 degrees.
zercher-good-morning.end_position: Hips pushed back and the torso hinged forward to about 45 degrees above horizontal with a neutral spine, knees still at the same soft bend, the barbell still cradled in the elbow crooks tight against the torso, head in line with the spine.

zercher-squat-barbell.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. Feet shoulder width with the toes slightly out. A barbell cradled in the crooks of both elbows against the torso at waist height, hands clasped together in front of the chest.
zercher-squat-barbell.end_position: Bottom of the squat: hips and knees bent so the thighs are at or just below parallel, knees tracking out over the toes, heels flat, torso leaning forward about 20 degrees with the spine neutral and the chest up. A barbell cradled in the crooks of both elbows against the torso at waist height, hands clasped together in front of the chest. unchanged in position on the body.

alpine-kick-step-traverse.start_position: Traversing across a steep snow slope that rises to the viewer's right, viewed from the front: body facing along the slope with the uphill (right) foot kicked into the slope on its inside edge, the downhill (left) foot planted below it on its outside edge, both knees bent, torso upright and leaning slightly into the slope, arms out for balance.
alpine-kick-step-traverse.end_position: Traversing across a steep snow slope that rises to the viewer's right, viewed from the front: body facing along the slope with the uphill (right) foot kicked into the slope on its inside edge, the downhill (left) foot planted below it on its outside edge, both knees bent, torso upright and leaning slightly into the slope, arms out for balance.

assault-bike.start_position: Seated upright on an air bike, viewed from the side, both hands gripping the tall moving handles at chest height with the right arm pushed forward and straight and the left arm pulled back with the elbow bent, right pedal at the bottom of the stroke with the leg nearly straight and the left knee bent up at the top of the stroke, torso upright with a slight forward lean, feet on the pedals. The bike's large front fan drawn as a simple circle.
assault-bike.end_position: Seated upright on an air bike, viewed from the side, both hands gripping the tall moving handles at chest height with the right arm pushed forward and straight and the left arm pulled back with the elbow bent, right pedal at the bottom of the stroke with the leg nearly straight and the left knee bent up at the top of the stroke, torso upright with a slight forward lean, feet on the pedals. The bike's large front fan drawn as a simple circle.

barefoot-grass-strides.start_position: Mid-stride running figure, moving to the viewer's right: torso upright with a slight forward lean from the ankles, right knee driven up in front with the thigh near horizontal and the foot under the knee, left leg extended behind with the toe just leaving the ground, arms bent 90 degrees swinging opposite to the legs, left arm forward, right arm back, hands relaxed. Barefoot, no shoes drawn, landing on the mid-foot.
barefoot-grass-strides.end_position: Mid-stride running figure, moving to the viewer's right: torso upright with a slight forward lean from the ankles, right knee driven up in front with the thigh near horizontal and the foot under the knee, left leg extended behind with the toe just leaving the ground, arms bent 90 degrees swinging opposite to the legs, left arm forward, right arm back, hands relaxed. Barefoot, no shoes drawn, landing on the mid-foot.

bmx-sprint-stand.start_position: Standing out of the saddle on a BMX bike, viewed from the side, moving to the viewer's right: hips up and back over the rear wheel, torso hinged forward about 45 degrees with the arms bent and both hands gripping the handlebars, right pedal driven down to the bottom of the stroke with the right leg nearly straight, left knee bent high at the top of the stroke, head up, eyes forward. Small-wheeled BMX bike drawn simply.
bmx-sprint-stand.end_position: Standing out of the saddle on a BMX bike, viewed from the side, moving to the viewer's right: hips up and back over the rear wheel, torso hinged forward about 45 degrees with the arms bent and both hands gripping the handlebars, right pedal driven down to the bottom of the stroke with the right leg nearly straight, left knee bent high at the top of the stroke, head up, eyes forward. Small-wheeled BMX bike drawn simply.

bmx-standing-start-sprint.start_position: Athletic ready stance facing the viewer's right: feet in a short split with the right foot forward, knees bent about 45 degrees, hips low, torso leaning forward about 45 degrees, both arms bent with the right arm back and the left arm forward, weight on the balls of the feet.
bmx-standing-start-sprint.end_position: First stride of a sprint to the viewer's right: rear (left) leg driving out fully straight behind with the toe on the ground, right knee driving forward and up, torso leaning forward about 45 degrees in one straight line from the rear heel to the head, arms swinging hard opposite to the legs.

caber-sandbag-flip.start_position: Standing tall with a long cylindrical sandbag held vertically against the front of the body: both hands cupped under the bottom end of the bag at hip height, the bag resting up against the right shoulder and rising above the head, knees softly bent, torso leaning slightly back to balance it.
caber-sandbag-flip.end_position: Release: knees and hips driven to full extension on the balls of the feet, torso upright, both arms extended fully up and forward, the sandbag tipped forward past vertical and leaving the hands, its top end falling away to the viewer's right.

capoeira-ginga.start_position: Ginga to one side: left foot stepped straight back with the left leg bent and the weight on it, right foot forward with the knee bent, torso low and leaning slightly forward, left arm raised across the front of the face with the elbow bent as a guard, right arm relaxed back, eyes forward.
capoeira-ginga.end_position: Ginga to the other side: right foot stepped straight back with the right leg bent and the weight on it, left foot forward with the knee bent, torso low, right arm raised across the front of the face with the elbow bent as a guard, left arm relaxed back. Mirror of the start.

casting-practice-drill.start_position: Fly-casting back stroke viewed from the side: feet shoulder width, torso upright, a thin rod held in the right hand with the upper arm at the side and the elbow bent to 90 degrees, the rod tip angled back over the shoulder at the 2 o'clock position just past vertical, wrist straight, left hand relaxed at the hip.
casting-practice-drill.end_position: Forward stroke stopped crisply: the same stance, the right elbow still bent near 90 degrees with the forearm driven forward, the rod tip stopped at the 10 o'clock position angled forward and up, wrist straight, left hand at the hip. Only the forearm and rod have moved.

clay-follow-through.start_position: Mounted shooting stance: feet shoulder width with the left foot slightly forward, knees soft, a long straight dowel held as a shotgun with the right hand at the grip and the left hand under the forend, the butt end tucked into the right shoulder, cheek down on the stock, both eyes along the dowel, muzzle pointed to the left at shoulder height.
clay-follow-through.end_position: Followed through: the same mount with the cheek still on the stock, the torso and dowel swung smoothly across to the right so the muzzle now points to the right at shoulder height, the hips turned with it, weight on the front foot, feet unchanged.

clean-and-jerk-barbell.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. A barbell resting in the front rack across the front of the shoulders, elbows high and pointing forward, fingertips under the bar just outside the shoulders.
clean-and-jerk-barbell.end_position: Split jerk lockout: arms fully extended straight overhead with the elbows locked, the bar directly above the shoulders and the mid-foot, head pushed slightly forward under the bar, eyes forward, feet split with the right foot forward on a bent knee and the left foot back on the ball of the foot with the leg straight, torso vertical.

cx-dismount-remount.start_position: Running to the viewer's right carrying a bicycle on the right shoulder: the bike's top tube resting on the shoulder with the right arm hooked under the down tube and the right hand gripping the handlebar to steady it, left arm swinging free, mid-stride with the left knee driving up and the right leg extended behind, torso upright with a slight forward lean.
cx-dismount-remount.end_position: Running to the viewer's right carrying a bicycle on the right shoulder: the bike's top tube resting on the shoulder with the right arm hooked under the down tube and the right hand gripping the handlebar to steady it, left arm swinging free, mid-stride with the left knee driving up and the right leg extended behind, torso upright with a slight forward lean.

deadlift-high-pull-barbell.start_position: Conventional deadlift set-up over a barbell on the floor: feet hip width, bar over mid-foot, hips hinged back higher than the knees, knees bent about 45 degrees, flat back angled about 45 degrees above horizontal, arms straight with the hands gripping the bar just outside the knees, shoulders over the bar.
deadlift-high-pull-barbell.end_position: Standing tall on the balls of the feet with the hips fully extended, the barbell pulled up to chin height close to the body with both elbows high and pointing out to the sides above the hands, shoulders shrugged up, torso vertical.

deep-water-fall-entry.start_position: Mid-air in a pencil position falling feet first, viewed from the front: body perfectly vertical and straight, legs together with the ankles crossed and the toes pointed down, both arms crossed over the chest with each hand gripping the opposite shoulder, chin tucked slightly, eyes forward. Nothing else drawn, no water or platform.
deep-water-fall-entry.end_position: Mid-air in a pencil position falling feet first, viewed from the front: body perfectly vertical and straight, legs together with the ankles crossed and the toes pointed down, both arms crossed over the chest with each hand gripping the opposite shoulder, chin tucked slightly, eyes forward. Nothing else drawn, no water or platform.

double-under.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. Feet together. Holding a jump rope by both handles at hip height with the elbows tucked at the sides and the forearms out, the rope lying on the floor behind the heels in a loop, drawn as a thin line.
double-under.end_position: Mid-air at the top of a small jump: both feet a few inches off the floor and together, ankles pointed, knees only slightly bent, torso upright and tall, elbows tucked at the sides with the forearms out at hip height, hands holding the rope handles, the rope drawn as a thin arc passing under the feet at the bottom of its swing.

double-unders-ski.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. Feet together. Holding a jump rope by both handles at hip height with the elbows tucked at the sides and the forearms out, the rope lying on the floor behind the heels in a loop, drawn as a thin line. Small quick jump on the balls of the feet.
double-unders-ski.end_position: Mid-air at the top of a small jump: both feet a few inches off the floor and together, ankles pointed, knees only slightly bent, torso upright and tall, elbows tucked at the sides with the forearms out at hip height, hands holding the rope handles, the rope drawn as a thin arc passing under the feet at the bottom of its swing. Small quick jump on the balls of the feet.

dryland-flutter-kick-weighted.start_position: Lying flat on the back on the floor with small ankle weights strapped above both ankles, lower back pressed into the floor, hands under the hips, both legs straight and raised together about 6 inches off the floor, toes pointed.
dryland-flutter-kick-weighted.end_position: Legs scissored: the right leg raised straight to about 12 inches and the left leg lowered straight to about 3 inches above the floor, both knees locked, ankle weights on, lower back still pressed down, hands under the hips.

elliptical-machine.start_position: Standing on an elliptical trainer viewed from the side, feet flat on the two pedals with the right pedal forward and high and the left pedal back and low, right knee bent and the left leg nearly straight, both hands gripping the tall moving arm handles with the left arm pushed forward and the right arm pulled back, torso upright, eyes forward.
elliptical-machine.end_position: Standing on an elliptical trainer viewed from the side, feet flat on the two pedals with the right pedal forward and high and the left pedal back and low, right knee bent and the left leg nearly straight, both hands gripping the tall moving arm handles with the left arm pushed forward and the right arm pulled back, torso upright, eyes forward.

fell-steep-hike-run.start_position: Mid-stride uphill on a slope rising to the viewer's right: torso leaning forward into the slope, right foot planted flat ahead on the higher ground with the knee bent, left leg behind with the heel lifting, arms swinging opposite to the legs. A trekking pole in each hand, the right pole planted ahead and the left behind, shafts angled back.
fell-steep-hike-run.end_position: Mid-stride uphill on a slope rising to the viewer's right: torso leaning forward into the slope, right foot planted flat ahead on the higher ground with the knee bent, left leg behind with the heel lifting, arms swinging opposite to the legs. A trekking pole in each hand, the right pole planted ahead and the left behind, shafts angled back.

fell-tech-descent.start_position: Running down a slope that falls to the viewer's right: torso upright and centred over the feet with a slight forward lean, right foot reaching down and forward to land on the lower ground with the knee soft, left leg trailing behind and above on the higher ground, both arms out wide from the shoulders with the elbows bent for balance, eyes on the ground ahead.
fell-tech-descent.end_position: Running down a slope that falls to the viewer's right: torso upright and centred over the feet with a slight forward lean, right foot reaching down and forward to land on the lower ground with the knee soft, left leg trailing behind and above on the higher ground, both arms out wide from the shoulders with the elbows bent for balance, eyes on the ground ahead.

fencing-footwork-ladder.start_position: En garde stance to the viewer's right: feet shoulder width apart in an L with the right foot pointing forward and the left foot pointing sideways, both knees bent about 30 degrees, torso upright and turned slightly sideways, right arm extended forward at chest height with the hand open, left arm bent behind. A flat agility ladder drawn on the floor under the feet as a row of rungs.
fencing-footwork-ladder.end_position: Full fencing lunge to the viewer's right: right leg driven forward with the knee bent to 90 degrees directly over the right foot, left leg fully straight behind with the left foot flat and still pointing sideways, torso upright, right arm fully extended forward at shoulder height, left arm extended straight back for balance. The ladder on the floor behind.

freestyle-ski-landing-jump.start_position: Standing tall on top of a knee-high plyo box with the feet hip width, knees soft, arms at the sides, ready to step off the front edge toward the viewer's right.
freestyle-ski-landing-jump.end_position: Landed on the floor in front of the box in a quarter squat: feet hip width and flat, knees bent about 45 degrees and tracking over the toes, hips back, torso leaning forward about 30 degrees with a flat back, arms forward at chest height for balance. The box behind.

hang-clean.start_position: Hang position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. A barbell held at mid-thigh on straight arms with a shoulder-width overhand grip, hips pushed back and the torso hinged forward about 30 degrees with a flat back, knees softly bent, shoulders over the bar.
hang-clean.end_position: Caught in a full front squat: A barbell resting in the front rack across the front of the shoulders, elbows high and pointing forward, fingertips under the bar just outside the shoulders. Thighs at or below parallel, knees out over the toes, heels flat, torso upright.

hang-power-clean.start_position: Hang position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. A barbell held at mid-thigh on straight arms with a shoulder-width overhand grip, hips pushed back and the torso hinged forward about 30 degrees with a flat back, knees softly bent, shoulders over the bar.
hang-power-clean.end_position: Caught in a quarter squat: A barbell resting in the front rack across the front of the shoulders, elbows high and pointing forward, fingertips under the bar just outside the shoulders. hang-snatch-barbell.start_position: Hang position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. hangboard-endurance-repeaters.start_position: Hanging from a hangboard mounted above a doorway, viewed from the side: both hands gripping a wide flat edge with the fingers in a half-crimp position, arms fully straight, shoulders engaged and slightly down, body hanging still and vertical with the legs together and the feet off the floor, knees softly bent.
hangboard-endurance-repeaters.end_position: Hanging from a hangboard mounted above a doorway, viewed from the side: both hands gripping a wide flat edge with the fingers in a half-crimp position, arms fully straight, shoulders engaged and slightly down, body hanging still and vertical with the legs together and the feet off the floor, knees softly bent.

heavy-bag-round.start_position: Boxing a heavy bag: orthodox stance with the left foot forward and the knees bent, the left arm fully extended in a straight jab with the fist landing on the front of a tall hanging heavy bag at head height, right fist held up guarding the chin with the elbow tucked, hips and shoulders rotated into the punch, rear heel lifted, chin down.
heavy-bag-round.end_position: Boxing a heavy bag: orthodox stance with the left foot forward and the knees bent, the left arm fully extended in a straight jab with the fist landing on the front of a tall hanging heavy bag at head height, right fist held up guarding the chin with the elbow tucked, hips and shoulders rotated into the punch, rear heel lifted, chin down.

hema-grapple-entry.start_position: Fighting stance facing a heavy bag at arm's length: left foot forward, knees bent, hips low, torso leaning slightly forward, both hands raised open in front of the chest, elbows in.

hema-zornhau.start_position: Vom Tag guard: feet shoulder width with the left foot forward, knees soft, a long straight dowel held as a longsword in both hands with the hilt beside the right shoulder at head height and the blade angled up and back over the shoulder, elbows bent, eyes forward.
hema-zornhau.end_position: Zornhau cut delivered: stepped forward with the right foot, both arms extended down and across to the left so the dowel points forward and down at hip height on the left side, the torso rotated to the left with the cut, hips turned, weight on the front foot.

high-cadence-spin.start_position: Seated on a stationary bike on a trainer, viewed from the side, hands on the handlebars, torso leaning forward about 40 degrees with a flat back, elbows softly bent. Fast easy spinning, upper body still.

Right pedal at the bottom of the stroke with the right leg nearly straight, left pedal at the top with the left knee bent up toward the chest, both feet on the pedals. Fast easy spinning, upper body still.

high-knee-skips.start_position: Skipping to the viewer's right: hopping on the left foot with the left leg straight and the heel just off the ground, right knee driven up high so the thigh is above horizontal with the foot dorsiflexed under the knee, torso tall, left arm driven forward and bent 90 degrees, right arm back.

hill-repeats-run.start_position: Running uphill to the viewer's right on a slope rising at about 10 degrees: torso leaning forward into the hill, right knee driven high in front, left leg extended behind pushing off the toe, arms bent 90 degrees swinging opposite to the legs, eyes up the slope.
hill-repeats-run.end_position: Running uphill to the viewer's right on a slope rising at about 10 degrees: torso leaning forward into the hill, right knee driven high in front, left leg extended behind pushing off the toe, arms bent 90 degrees swinging opposite to the legs, eyes up the slope.

iaido-paper-cut-test.start_position: Ready position: feet shoulder width with the left foot forward, knees soft, a long straight dowel held as a sword in both hands overhead with the hilt above and slightly in front of the forehead and the blade angled up and back, elbows bent, eyes forward.
iaido-paper-cut-test.end_position: Cut completed: both arms extended forward and down so the dowel points straight forward at shoulder height, stopped level, edge aligned with the direction of the cut, torso upright with the weight on the front foot, knees bent slightly.

ice-tool-swing-rot.start_position: Standing in a square stance with the feet shoulder width, a medicine ball held in both hands at the left hip with the torso rotated to the left and the knees softly bent, arms slightly bent.
ice-tool-swing-rot.end_position: Torso rotated up and across to the right with the medicine ball swung overhead on nearly straight arms to the upper right above the head, weight shifted to the right foot, left heel lifted and pivoted, eyes on the ball.

indoor-cycle-seated-threshold.start_position: Seated on a stationary bike on a trainer, viewed from the side, hands on the handlebars, torso leaning forward about 40 degrees with a flat back, elbows softly bent. Right pedal at the bottom of the stroke with the right leg nearly straight, left pedal at the top with the left knee bent up toward the chest, both feet on the pedals. Steady hard seated effort, hands on the hoods.
indoor-cycle-seated-threshold.end_position: Seated on a stationary bike on a trainer, viewed from the side, hands on the handlebars, torso leaning forward about 40 degrees with a flat back, elbows softly bent. Right pedal at the bottom of the stroke with the right leg nearly straight, left pedal at the top with the left knee bent up toward the chest, both feet on the pedals. Steady hard seated effort, hands on the hoods.

indoor-cycling-standing-climb.start_position: Standing out of the saddle on a stationary bike on a trainer, viewed from the side: hips up and slightly forward off the saddle, torso leaning forward about 45 degrees, both hands gripping the handlebars with the arms bent, right pedal driven down to the bottom of the stroke with the right leg nearly straight, left knee bent at the top of the stroke, head up.
indoor-cycling-standing-climb.end_position: Standing out of the saddle on a stationary bike on a trainer, viewed from the side: hips up and slightly forward off the saddle, torso leaning forward about 45 degrees, both hands gripping the handlebars with the arms bent, right pedal driven down to the bottom of the stroke with the right leg nearly straight, left knee bent at the top of the stroke, head up.

indoor-zone-2.start_position: Seated on a stationary bike on a trainer, viewed from the side, hands on the handlebars, torso leaning forward about 40 degrees with a flat back, elbows softly bent. Right pedal at the bottom of the stroke with the right leg nearly straight, left pedal at the top with the left knee bent up toward the chest, both feet on the pedals. Relaxed conversational effort, elbows soft.
indoor-zone-2.end_position: Seated on a stationary bike on a trainer, viewed from the side, hands on the handlebars, torso leaning forward about 40 degrees with a flat back, elbows softly bent. Right pedal at the bottom of the stroke with the right leg nearly straight, left pedal at the top with the left knee bent up toward the chest, both feet on the pedals. Relaxed conversational effort, elbows soft.

judo-bridge-hip-escape.start_position: Bridge on a mat: lying on the back with the knees bent and the feet flat close to the hips, hips driven straight up so the body is a straight line from the shoulders to the knees, weight on the upper back and feet, arms bent with the hands up in front of the chest.
judo-bridge-hip-escape.end_position: Hip escape (shrimp): turned onto the right hip and side, both hands pushing away at chest height, the hips shot backward away from the hands so the body folds into a V, right leg straight along the mat and the left knee bent with the left foot pushing the mat, head up.

jump-rope.start_position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. Feet together. Holding a jump rope by both handles at hip height with the elbows tucked at the sides and the forearms out, the rope lying on the floor behind the heels in a loop, drawn as a thin line.
jump-rope.end_position: Mid-air at the top of a small jump: both feet a few inches off the floor and together, ankles pointed, knees only slightly bent, torso upright and tall, elbows tucked at the sides with the forearms out at hip height, hands holding the rope handles, the rope drawn as a thin arc passing under the feet at the bottom of its swing.

jump-shrug-barbell.start_position: Hang position: Standing tall, feet hip width, knees straight but not locked, spine neutral, eyes forward. A barbell held at mid-thigh on straight arms with a shoulder-width overhand grip, hips pushed back and the torso hinged forward about 30 degrees with a flat back, knees softly bent.
jump-shrug-barbell.end_position: Full extension: hips and knees locked out and the body tall on the tips of the toes with the heels high off the floor, both shoulders shrugged hard up toward the ears, arms still straight with the barbell hanging at the hips, torso vertical.

jump-squat.start_position: Loaded quarter squat: feet shoulder width, knees bent about 45 degrees, hips back, torso leaning forward about 30 degrees with a flat back, both arms swung back behind the hips.
jump-squat.end_position: Mid-air at the top of the jump: body fully extended in one straight vertical line, feet off the floor with the toes pointed down, knees and hips straight, both arms swung up overhead.

jumping-jack.start_position: Standing tall facing the viewer with the feet together and the arms straight down at the sides, palms in.
jumping-jack.end_position: Jumped out: feet wide apart beyond shoulder width and flat on the floor, legs straight, both arms raised straight up overhead with the hands nearly touching above the head, body forming an X.

jumping-switch-lunge-tkd.start_position: Split-stance lunge with the right foot forward: right knee bent to 90 degrees over the right foot, left knee lowered to just above the floor behind, left heel up, torso upright, arms bent at the sides.
jumping-switch-lunge-tkd.end_position: Landed in the opposite lunge after switching in the air: left foot now forward with the left knee bent to 90 degrees over the left foot, right knee lowered to just above the floor behind, right heel up, torso upright, arms bent at the sides.

karate-kata-flow.start_position: Zenkutsu-dachi front stance with a low block, viewed from three-quarter front: left leg forward with the knee bent to 90 degrees over the left foot, right leg straight back with the foot flat and turned out, torso upright and square to the front, left arm extended down and forward in a low block with the fist just above the left knee, right fist pulled back to the right hip palm up, eyes forward.
